correctness.rationale: Exact normalized-path cosine eigensystem, finite spectral-Vandermonde decomposition, and complete one-variable extrema provide a proof for all path lengths and all spectral multipliers injective on the m active frequencies. For m=4, the key global polynomial bound is (10+7sqrt(7))/108<21/64 and the six remaining path lengths are computed exactly. Direct verifier checks test independent matrix determinants and finite classification without claiming that enumeration proves the theorem.

value.rationale: Minimally timed one-sensor dynamical observations of lowpass graph Paley–Wiener spaces have a natural D-optimal design question. Complete classification for m=2,3,4 exposes a structural migration from endpoints (known for the full spectrum) to the first interiors for long paths, resolves all sharp small-path ties, and quantifies a sixteen-fold limiting determinant advantage for four modes. A naturally motivated first nonlinear lowpass threshold, not arbitrary parameter fitting.
